title: Python for Data Science Bootcamp
description: Master the fundamentals of Python programming for data analysis. Covers variables, data structures (lists, dictionaries, sets), functions, and an introduction to pandas for data manipulation.

title: Advanced Python Patterns & Algorithms
description: Deep dive into advanced Python concepts like decorators, generators, memory management, and optimizing algorithmic complexity for high-performance data pipelines.

title: SQL Aggregations & Window Functions
description: Learn to write complex SQL queries using GROUP BY, HAVING, subqueries, and advanced window functions to aggregate and analyze relational data efficiently.

title: Statistics for Machine Learning
description: A comprehensive guide to statistics required for machine learning. Covers probability distributions, Bayes' theorem, p-values, A/B testing, and hypothesis testing.

title: Applied Linear Algebra for Data Scientists
description: Understand the mathematical foundations behind machine learning algorithms. Focuses on matrix operations, eigenvalues, eigenvectors, and dimensionality reduction techniques like PCA.

title: Machine Learning Fundamentals
description: Core concepts of supervised and unsupervised learning. Build linear regression, logistic regression, decision trees, and k-means clustering models from scratch.

title: Precision, Recall & ROC-AUC Deep Dive
description: Interactive exercises focused solely on model evaluation metrics. Learn when to optimize for Precision vs Recall, how to plot ROC curves, and how to handle imbalanced datasets.

title: Hyperparameter Tuning with GridSearch & RandomSearch
description: Learn to systematically improve model performance by tuning hyperparameters using Grid Search, Random Search, and Bayesian Optimization. Identify and resolve overfitting.

title: Hands-on Customer Churn Classifier
description: An end-to-end guided project where you clean telecom data, engineer features, train a Random Forest classifier, evaluate its performance, and extract feature importance to predict customer churn.

title: Introduction to Deep Learning & Neural Networks
description: Step into modern AI with this introductory deep learning course. Covers perceptrons, backpropagation, activation functions, and building multi-layer neural networks using PyTorch.

title: Feature Engineering Masterclass
description: The secret to highly accurate models is great features. Learn imputation, handling outliers, encoding categorical variables, scaling, and generating polynomial features.

title: Building CI/CD Pipelines for ML Models
description: Bridge the gap between ML and software engineering. Learn to package models using Docker, set up GitHub Actions for testing, and deploy models as REST APIs using FastAPI.
